sources.author: Stephen Boyd
sources.title: EE263 Lecture 15 Symmetric matrices, quadratic forms, matrix norm, and SVD
sections_checked: slides 15-2 to 15-7: spectral decomposition and distinct-eigenvalue orthogonality
slides 15-10 to 15-14: quadratic forms and definiteness
conditions_applied: Real symmetric is required for orthogonal eigenbasis.
Repeated eigenvalues allow a choice of orthogonal basis; arbitrary eigenvectors need not be orthogonal.
Positive semidefinite means a quadratic-form condition, not nonnegative entries.
sources.use: Theorem conditions checked; examples, prose and figures independently created.

sources.author: Stephen Boyd and Sanjay Lall
sources.title: Singular Value Decomposition EE263 Autumn 2015
sections_checked: pages 22-26: square invertible condition number and spectral low-rank proof
conditions_applied: Square invertible hypothesis retained for inverse-norm condition number proof.
Terminology thin/compact differs by source; explicit dimensions define this lesson.
Orthogonal transforms can include reflections; they are not all pure rotations.
No unqualified rectangular least-squares relative-error bound is imported.
sources.use: Construction and lower-bound argument checked; all teaching examples newly developed.

sources.author: Sébastien Roch
sources.title: Mathematical Methods in Data Science 4.2 Background review of matrix rank and spectral decomposition
conditions_applied: Eigenvectors exclude zero; an eigenspace includes zero.
A full spectral-theorem proof is not claimed without the needed existence argument.
sources.use: Cross-check of theorem statement and scope, not copied exposition.

sources.author: Sébastien Roch
sources.title: Mathematical Methods in Data Science 4.6 Further applications of the SVD low-rank approximations and ridge regression
sections_checked: Matrix Norms and Singular Values Truncation lemma
Low-Rank Approximation in the Induced Norm theorem
conditions_applied: Squared Frobenius error is the sum of omitted squared singular values.
Spectral error is the first omitted singular value.
Rank at most k and complete unweighted matrix loss are specified.
sources.use: Error formulas and theorem conditions cross-checked; original projection proof and examples supplied.

sources.author: NumPy Developers
sources.title: NumPy 2.3 numpy.linalg.eigh
conditions_applied: Input must be real symmetric for this lesson.
Eigenvalues ascending; normalized eigenvectors in columns.
Selected triangular part is used; the wrapper explicitly rejects nonsymmetric input.
Course wrapper deliberately rejects boolean/string/object inputs before float conversion, beyond NumPy general coercion behavior.
sources.use: Interface contract verified against NumPy 2.3.5 execution.

sources.author: NumPy Developers
sources.title: NumPy 2.3 numpy.linalg.eig
sections_checked: Notes on complex values and rank of returned eigenvectors
conditions_applied: General real matrices may produce complex eigenvalues.
Eigenvalues not necessarily ordered.
Eigenvectors need not form a full-rank or orthogonal basis.
sources.use: Rotation and shear counterexamples matched to interface scope.

sources.author: NumPy Developers
sources.title: NumPy 2.3 numpy.linalg.svd
conditions_applied: s is a vector; Vh is already transposed for real inputs.
Reduced dimensions use min(m,n), not estimated rank.
Nonnegative singular values descending.
sources.use: All real full/reduced reconstructions executed; no production implementation by eig(A.T@A) is recommended.

sources.author: NumPy Developers
sources.title: NumPy 2.3 numpy.linalg.cond
conditions_applied: 2-norm condition ratio checked by SVD.
Finite ratio on a full-row-rank wide matrix does not imply trivial input null space.
sources.use: Square condition identity and wide counterexample both executed.

additional_source_cautions.caution: The unqualified uniqueness sentence for the Frobenius minimizer is not adopted. Repeated singular values at the truncation boundary yield counterexamples. Lesson and Exercise 17 give the strict-gap condition and distinguish spectral-norm nonuniqueness.

unverified_attempts.use: Not counted as an inspected or cited source; official author-hosted Stanford and Roch materials used instead.
